Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 91. Category: form. God Form.

Godly Transformation
You have merged your demon form with your regular
form making an insanely powerful demon mode.
Increase your Power by 4
Increase your Movement Speed by 30 ft.
You gain a +4 to your Maximum and Current
Strength and Charisma Ability Score
Increase the Damage Die for unarmed strikes,
Techniques, Ki Blasts, and Spells by 1 step.
You gain the Super-Charged Condition
At the end of your turn, you lose 5 Stamina
Demigra (Makyouka Form)
